keywords.def: stage of life when a person grows from a child into an adult because of changes in the body’s sexual reproductive system
have your feelings and emotions easily hurt
make something seem less important than it really is
manage to survive a difficult experience or challenging period of life
describes medicine that can be bought in a shop without a doctor’s prescription
source or cause of persistent unhappiness or misfortune

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 这里是BBC英语教学的《6 Minute English》。

sentences.en: I’m Neil. And I’m Beth. As a society, we’re obsessed with our skin.
sentences.zh: 我是Neil。我是Beth。作为一个社会，我们对自己的皮肤有着近乎痴迷的关注。

sentences.en: But the pursuit of perfect skin can make life difficult for people who struggle with skin conditions.
sentences.zh: 但是，对完美皮肤的追求让那些与皮肤问题作斗争的人生活变得艰难。

sentences.en: ‘Spots’, ‘zits’ or ‘pimples’ - there are many names for the red, inflamed marks which appear on the face and neck, but the medical term is acne.
sentences.zh: “粉刺”、“青春痘”或“暗疮”——出现在面部和颈部的红色红肿斑痕有许多不同的叫法，但医学术语是痤疮。

sentences.en: Acne is a skin condition which can affect anyone.
sentences.zh: 痤疮是一种会影响任何人的皮肤病。

sentences.en: It often happens between the ages of 14 and 19, but can continue into adulthood.
sentences.zh: 它通常发生在14岁到19岁之间，但也可能持续到成年。

sentences.en: There are many types of acne from blackheads and whiteheads to more severe forms of cysts and scarring.
sentences.zh: 痤疮有许多类型，从黑头、白头到更严重的囊肿和疤痕。

sentences.en: But whatever the type of acne, looking different from others can be emotionally damaging, especially during the teenage years when our self-image and physical appearance are changing.
sentences.zh: 但无论是什么类型的痤疮，看起来与别人不同都会对心理造成伤害，尤其是在青少年的年龄段，此时我们的自我形象和外表正在发生变化。

sentences.en: In this programme, we’ll be hearing from a skin doctor, or dermatologist, who suffered acne herself.
sentences.zh: 在这期节目中，我们将听到一位皮肤科医生（即dermatologist）的讲述，她自己也曾饱受痤疮之苦。

sentences.en: And, as usual, we’ll be learning some useful new vocabulary too.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，我们也将学到一些实用的新词汇。

sentences.en: But first I have a question for you, Beth.
sentences.zh: 但首先我有一个问题要问你，Beth。

sentences.en: Mild or moderate acne is very common in teenagers and younger adults, so according to the UK’s National Health Service, what proportion of people aged 11 to 30 experience some amount of acne?
sentences.zh: 轻度或中度痤疮在青少年和年轻成年人中非常普遍，那么根据英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的数据，11岁到30岁的人群中有多少比例经历过某种程度的痤疮？

sentences.en: a) 75%? b) 85%? or c) 95%? I'm going to guess that it is c) 95%.
OK, Beth, we’ll find out if that’s the correct answer at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 好的，Beth，我们在节目结束时来揭晓这是否是正确答案。

sentences.en: Dr Sharon Crichlow is a dermatologist originally from Barbados.
sentences.zh: Sharon Crichlow医生是一位皮肤科医生，原籍巴巴多斯。

sentences.en: As someone who grew up with acne she understands the impact it can have on a person's mental health, as she explains here to BBC World Service programme, The Conversation.
sentences.zh: 作为一个带着痤疮长大的人，她深知痤疮对一个人心理健康的冲击，正如她在这里向BBC世界频道的节目《The Conversation》所解释的那样。

sentences.en: Well, we know for sure that it does tend to arise from puberty onwards, so the biggest cohort of patients is in the teenage age group.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们确定的是它往往从青春期开始出现，所以最大的患者群体是青少年年龄段。

sentences.en: However a proportion of patients up to 20 or so percent - certainly in females - it will persist well into the 30s, 40s - much longer than people often give it credit for.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一部分患者——高达20%左右，特别是女性——这种情况会一直持续到30多岁、40多岁，比人们通常认为的时间要长得多。

sentences.en: And we also know that it has a huge psychological impact so even mild to moderate acne, because it affects teenagers who are quite emotionally vulnerable, it affects their friendships, their peer groups and so it should never really be trivialised.
sentences.zh: 并且我们也知道它会产生巨大的心理影响，所以即使是轻度到中度的痤疮，因为它影响的是在情感上相当脆弱的青少年，它会影响他们的友谊、同龄人群体，所以它绝不应该被轻视。

sentences.en: Acne tends to start during puberty, the stage in people’s lives when they develop from a child into an adult because of changes in their body.
sentences.zh: 痤疮往往在青春期开始，这是由于身体的变化，人们从儿童发育为成人的生命阶段。

sentences.en: Hormones such as testosterone which are released into the body during puberty often cause acne to appear.
sentences.zh: 诸如睾酮之类的激素在青春期释放到体内，通常会导致痤疮出现。

sentences.en: Of course, puberty involves emotional, as well as physical, changes.
sentences.zh: 当然，青春期既涉及情感变化，也涉及身体变化。

sentences.en: Acne can be harder to live with for someone who is emotionally vulnerable, meaning someone who gets their feelings hurt easily.
sentences.zh: 对于情感上脆弱的人来说，痤疮可能更难忍受，这意味着那些容易受伤害的人。

sentences.en: Acne affects your confidence and how you interact with the world, so it shouldn’t be trivialised, or made to seem less important than it really is.
sentences.zh: 痤疮会影响你的自信以及你与世界互动的方式，所以它不应该被轻视，或者被表现得比实际情况更不重要。

sentences.en: At times, most teenagers are self-conscious about their looks, and having acne adds to social pressure.
sentences.zh: 有时候，大多数青少年对自己的外表感到自我意识过强，而长青春痘则增加了社交压力。

sentences.en: Acne is largely genetic, and the buildup of oil and bacteria in the pores of the skin which causes spots is due to hormones which are completely natural.
sentences.zh: 痤疮在很大程度上具有遗传性，皮肤毛孔中油脂和细菌的积聚导致了斑刺的出现，这是由于完全自然的荷尔蒙引起的。

sentences.en: Here’s Dr Sharon Crichlow, again, telling BBC World Service programme, The Conversation, how her own experience with acne led her to help others with the same problem: I didn't have the luxury of being able to see a dermatologist when I was younger - my family just simply couldn't afford it, so I had to get through it as best I could… and you just you know tried everything over the counter et cetera.
sentences.zh: 这里又是Sharon Crichlow医生，她向BBC世界频道节目《The Conversation》讲述了她自己与痤疮的经历如何促使她去帮助有同样问题的人：我年轻的时候可没有奢侈到能去看皮肤科医生——我的家庭根本负担不起，所以我只能尽我所能挺过去……而且你知道的，你只能尝试各种非处方药等等。

sentences.en: I just felt if I could help people with something that has been such a bane of my life and having that inside experience as well so I would often tell my patients, pretty much anything I recommend to them, I've tried it myself, I can tell them, it works…
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，如果我能用一个曾是我生命中如此大患的问题去帮助人们，并且也拥有那种内在的经历，所以我经常会告诉我的患者，我推荐给他们的几乎任何东西，我自己都尝试过，我可以告诉他们，这是管用的……

sentences.en: Growing up, Dr Crichlow didn’t have anyone to help her get through acne.
sentences.zh: 在成长过程中，Crichlow医生没有人帮助她度过痤疮。

sentences.en: If you get through something, you manage to survive a difficult experience or challenging period in life.
sentences.zh: 如果你度过了（get through）某事，你就设法在生活中的困难经历或充满挑战的时期中生存了下来。

sentences.en: Instead, she got whatever medicine she could buy without a doctor’s prescription - known as over the counter medicines - from her local pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 相反，她从当地药店买到了任何不需要医生处方就能买到的药物——也就是所谓的非处方药（over the counter medicines）。

sentences.en: Dr Crichlow calls acne, the bane of my life, an idiom meaning the cause of unhappiness or misfortune.
sentences.zh: Crichlow医生把痤疮称为我生命中的大患（the bane of my life），这是一个习语，意思是带来不幸或痛苦的根源。

sentences.en: But as she grew older and her acne improved, she used her experience to support her patients in the UK.
sentences.zh: 但随着她年龄的增长，痤疮有所改善，她用自己的经历来支持英国的患者。

sentences.en: For most people acne stops as they grow older, but remember it’s completely natural and you’re not alone.
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，随着年龄增长痤疮会停止，但请记住这是完全自然的，你并不孤单。

sentences.en: Which reminds me of my question, Beth – what proportion of 11 to 30 year-olds get acne to some extent?
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了我的问题，Beth——11到30岁的人群中，有多少比例在某种程度上长痤疮？

sentences.en: You said it was 95%, which was… the correct answer!
sentences.zh: 你说的是95%，这是……正确答案！

sentences.en: OK, let’s recap the vocabulary we’ve learned, starting with puberty, the stage of life when a person changes from a child to an adult.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下我们学过的词汇，从“青春期（puberty）”开始，这是一个人从儿童转变为成人的生命阶段。

sentences.en: Someone who is emotionally vulnerable has their feelings and emotions easily hurt.
sentences.zh: 情感脆弱（emotionally vulnerable）的人是指其感情和情绪容易受到伤害的人。

sentences.en: The verb to trivialise means to make something seem less important than it really is.
sentences.zh: 动词“轻视（trivialise）”意思是让某事显得比实际上更不重要。

sentences.en: If you get through it, you manage to survive a difficult experience or period of life.
sentences.zh: 如果你度过了难关（get through it），你就能设法在困难的经历或生命时期中生存下来。

sentences.en: Over the counter medicines can be bought in a shop without a doctor’s prescription.
sentences.zh: 非处方药（Over the counter medicines）可以在商店里买到，不需要医生处方。

sentences.en: And finally, the idiom, the bane of my life refers to a source of persistent unhappiness or misfortune.
sentences.zh: 最后，“我生命中的大患（the bane of my life）”这个习语指的是持续痛苦或不幸的根源。

sentences.en: Once again our six minutes are up, but remember to join us again next time for more trending topics and useful vocabulary, here at 6 Minute English.
sentences.zh: 我们的六分钟节目又到时间了，但请记住下次继续收看我们更多的热门话题和实用词汇，就在《6 Minute English》。

sentences.en: Goodbye for now! Bye!
sentences.zh: 先到这里！再见！
